environment.description: EKS pod running with the same code and IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/FileProcessorRole). The role has an attached IAM permission boundary policy (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/DataProcessorBoundary) that denies s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject on any path outside the designated prefix. Additionally, the pod runs in a namespace governed by a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-volume-writes' that enforces readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and only allows writable emptyDir mounts at /var/data/processed (with a 500Mi sizeLimit). The node-level AppArmor profile 'k8s-file-processor' is loaded and annotated on the pod, confining write() syscalls to paths matching /var/data/processed/** only. The container runs as UID 65534 (nobody) with allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and drops ALL capabilities.
